chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 5: Alchemical Pills and the Test of Reality
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang receives five alchemical pills from Danyangzi and a promotion to registered disciple. When the pills cross into his hospital room, he must decide whether to trust the fading line between hallucination and reality.
og_title: Chapter 5: Alchemical Pills – The First Object Crosses Over
og_description: Li Huowang receives pills from Danyangzi and a promotion to Xuan Yang. But when the pills appear in his hospital room, he can no longer pretend the cave world is just a dream.
twitter_description: Li Huowang gets promoted and gifted five pills—then they follow him to the hospital. Reality just got a lot more complicated.
